build_note: Listed 6-2, 195 lb (Basketball-Reference, Wikipedia); 6-4 wingspan (2011 combine, Tankathon)
story: Up 4 after three, Dallas scored 11 straight in 69 seconds and won 110–100.
aria: Animated Short: Kyrie Irving's 26-foot pull-up three in transition with 3:30 left, after a Daniel Gafford steal, that made it 100–88 during an 11–0 Dallas run. Mavericks win 110–100. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
